ns2:section.sectionText: Source Lab. Students must register for both the lecture (CRN: 62721) and the lab (CRN: 63240). This special section of HIST 398 spearheads a new digital publishing initiative. Students will learn how to create reliable editions of online materials, so that they can be used as historical sources. They'll earn course credit for the class, and if their sources are published, will be listed authors on the resulting additions. Contact instructor for details on this exciting new course (Professor John Randolph, jwr@illinois.edu).
